name: snagline
description: Integrate an agent with a Snagline support fabric within its trust boundaries: read cases and advice, claim deliveries with snagline-front, submit one final advice with snagline-dispatcher, and verify SSP artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Operate a Snagline support fabric within its trust boundaries
interface.longDescription: Read Snagline cases and the advice that comes back, claim deliveries with snagline-front, submit the single final advice with snagline-dispatcher, and verify SSP artifacts. Explains why no shipped client opens a case and why an agent must never hold the edge UID.
defaultPrompt: Use Snagline to show me the advice on this case.
